body.p: He has a tent. He has a wife. He has a child, a boy. They three live in the tent. There is a neighbour's tent. Neighbour's tent - is of mouse-oldman. The mouse-oldman has a wife. He has a daugther. The son of the bird-oldman keeps coming all the time to the daugther of the mouse-oldman and plaits her hair. And if they plait his hair, then the son of the bird-oldman comes to the daughter of the mouse-oldman by night, as well. The bird-oldman sees his son, and he goes to the mouse-oldman to do the matchmaking. Finally he took her away. The children have moved away, they live together. They live like so, until the snow comes. The bird-oldman says: "It seems, I'm going to freeze. I will freeze. Where is my land? The summer passed, and I will fly away, it seems." Mouse-oldman (says): "What are you going to do with your son and daughter"? "How can she reach my land? If she had wings, she would fly". "Our children have started to live together". "Who would separate them?" "How can I carry the child of the mouse-oldman?" "Have to carry her some-how." The wife of the bird-oldman, being sorry for her son, started to cry. "How would my child reach that far away land?""If she had wings, she would fly." "I won't let my child go." "Why can't the son of the bird-oldman (his child) be left here? "Let him try for one year." "Perhaps he does not die." The bird-oldman says: "All right, my son would stay." "Let him stay on the plain." "It is cold-cold-cold, tomorrow we are leaving." In the morning, the bird-oldman left, and he left his son. In autumn, the son of the bird-oldman and the daughter of mouse-oldman sleep together. She awoke. The son of the bird-oldman is still sleeping. So he is sleeping, but his wife is stronger. The daughter of the mouse nibbled at him, gnawed him clean.
